q: In 2 Timothy, Paul says all Scripture is what?
In 2 Timothy, what is God-breathed Scripture useful for?
quote: and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness

q: In 2 Timothy, since when had Timothy known the Holy Scriptures?
quote: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures

q: In 2 Timothy, the Scriptures make you wise for what?
quote: which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

q: In 2 Timothy, Scripture equips the man of God for every what?
quote: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.

q: In 2 Timothy, what does Paul tell Timothy to continue in?
quote: But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed

q: In 2 Timothy, right after describing God-breathed Scripture, what does Paul charge Timothy to preach?
why: In season and out of season.
quote: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season

q: In 2 Timothy, God has not given us a spirit of what?
why: He gives power, love, and self-control.
quote: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

q: In 2 Timothy, near the end of his life, what did Paul say he had kept?
quote: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.

q: In 2 Timothy, in whom did Timothy's sincere faith first dwell?
quote: which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice

q: In 2 Timothy, Paul tells Timothy to suffer like a good what?
quote: Join me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

q: In 2 Timothy, a workman approved by God accurately handles what?
why: He has no need to be ashamed.
quote: an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.

q: In 2 Timothy, what crown did Paul say was laid up for him?
quote: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness

q: In 2 Timothy, what will come in the last days?
why: People will love themselves and money.
quote: In the last days terrible times will come.

q: In 2 Timothy, what was the name of Timothy's mother?
In 2 Timothy, who was the only one still with Paul?
In 2 Timothy, whom did Paul ask Timothy to bring because he was useful?
quote: Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.

q: In 2 Timothy, where had Paul left his cloak with Carpus?
quote: bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
